data.change_summary: No additional amendments were required after review; the previously applied shrimp stage-model fixes stand as the final implementation. The workspace now uses deterministic signed-carry adult-to-berried and hatch transfers with reachable molt failures, preserves legacy/current saves via defaulted carry fields plus v4->v5/runtime stage-parameter wiring and invariant validation, and exposes readable total/sub-adult shrimp breakdowns across snapshot/API/TUI/harness surfaces with targeted regression coverage.
outstanding_risks: Legacy-only maturation-days inputs still map to juvenile/sub-adult durations via the documented 60/40 split; callers that need different stage timing must set explicit stage durations or populate `state.shrimp_params` directly.

`cargo test --workspace` still reports the pre-existing `step_hours_leaves_state_untouched_when_clamps_precede_a_validation_error` failure from bead 6e5.7.1; this task did not address that regression.

The updated TUI stage breakdown is compile-validated and the core/harness/API surfaces are regression-tested, but there are still no dedicated TUI render snapshots or full end-to-end scenario reruns for the new text.
